overnightPermit.what: Mount Rainier NP wilderness permit, plus climbing registration (fee) above 10,000 ft or on glaciers
overnightPermit.where: Reserve a wilderness permit in advance and pay the climbing fee online, then register at a park wilderness information center before the climb; about half of each camp is held for walk-ups.

overnightPermit.what: North Cascades NP wilderness permit — quota, fee
overnightPermit.where: Reserve on Recreation.gov; permits for Cascade River Road trailheads must be picked up in person at the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center.

overnightPermit.what: North Cascades NP wilderness permit for the Stehekin valley camps — quota, fee
overnightPermit.where: Reserve on Recreation.gov and contact the park the day before, as there are no permit services in Stehekin. Camping beyond the park boundary in the Glacier Peak Wilderness needs no park permit.
